description: Dissolves an object using a noise texture, revealing or hiding geometry along a threshold. Commonly used for death effects, teleportation, and material transitions.

properties.name: _DissolveAmount
properties.description: Controls how much of the object is dissolved. 0 = fully visible, 1 = fully dissolved.

properties.name: _NoiseTex
properties.description: Grayscale noise texture that drives the dissolve pattern.

properties.name: _EdgeColor
properties.description: Color of the glowing edge at the dissolve boundary.

properties.name: _EdgeWidth
properties.description: Width of the glowing edge effect in UV space.

shader_graph_nodes: Sample Texture 2D (noise texture) -> Split R channel
Subtract: noise R - DissolveAmount property
Step or Smoothstep node for edge detection
Lerp between base color and edge color using edge mask
Connect edge mask to Alpha Clip Threshold on the Master Stack

description: Renders a visible outline around objects. Used for selection highlights, toon rendering, and interactable object indication.

properties.name: _OutlineColor
properties.description: Color of the outline.

properties.name: _OutlineWidth
properties.description: Thickness of the outline in clip space or world units.

properties.name: _OutlineMode
properties.description: 0 = vertex extrusion, 1 = screen-space post-process.

shader_graph_nodes: Position node (Object Space) + Normal Vector node
Multiply normal by OutlineWidth property
Add offset position to original position
Use a separate Shader Graph for the outline pass with Cull Front
For screen-space: use a Full Screen Render Feature with Sobel edge detection

description: Brightens or colors the edges of an object based on view angle. Used for shields, holographic effects, and rim lighting.

properties.name: _FresnelColor
properties.description: Color applied to the fresnel rim effect.

properties.name: _FresnelPower
properties.description: Controls the falloff of the fresnel effect. Higher values create a tighter rim.

properties.name: _FresnelIntensity
properties.description: Multiplier for the overall brightness of the fresnel effect.

shader_graph_nodes: Fresnel Effect node (built-in) with Power property input
Multiply fresnel output by FresnelColor and Intensity properties
Add fresnel contribution to base color output
Connect to Emission on Master Stack for glow effect
Optional: animate Power over time using Time node for pulsing

description: Cel-shading effect that quantizes lighting into discrete bands for a cartoon or anime art style.

properties.name: _BaseColor
properties.description: Main tint color of the surface.

properties.name: _ShadowColor
properties.description: Color used for shadowed areas instead of darkening.

properties.name: _ShadowThreshold
properties.description: NdotL threshold where shadow begins.

properties.name: _ShadowSmoothness
properties.description: Smoothness of the shadow-to-light transition.

properties.name: _SpecularSize
properties.description: Size of the specular highlight band.

shader_graph_nodes: Dot Product of Normal and Main Light Direction
Smoothstep node with Shadow Threshold and Smoothness inputs
Lerp between Shadow Color and Base Color using step result
For specular: Dot product of Normal and Half Direction, then Step node
Custom Function node for GetMainLight if using Shader Graph in URP

description: Stylized or semi-realistic water surface with scrolling normals, depth-based coloring, and vertex displacement.

properties.name: _ShallowColor
properties.description: Water color in shallow areas near the shore.

properties.name: _DeepColor
properties.description: Water color in deep areas away from the shore.

properties.name: _DepthMaxDistance
properties.description: Depth distance over which color transitions from shallow to deep.

properties.name: _NormalMap1
properties.description: First scrolling normal map for surface ripples.

properties.name: _NormalMap2
properties.description: Second scrolling normal map at a different speed and direction.

properties.name: _WaveHeight
properties.description: Amplitude of vertex displacement waves.

properties.name: _WaveSpeed
properties.description: Speed of the wave animation.

shader_graph_nodes: Sine/Cosine of (Position.x + Time) for vertex wave displacement
Scene Depth node minus Surface Depth for depth-based color blending
Lerp between Shallow Color and Deep Color using depth difference
Two Tiling And Offset nodes with Time-driven offset for scrolling normals
Normal Blend node to combine both normal maps, connect to Normal on Master Stack

description: Sci-fi holographic projection effect with scan lines, flickering, and transparent rendering.

properties.name: _HoloColor
properties.description: Primary color of the hologram.

properties.name: _ScanLineSpeed
properties.description: Speed at which horizontal scan lines scroll.

properties.name: _ScanLineDensity
properties.description: Number of scan lines per unit of world space.

properties.name: _FlickerSpeed
properties.description: Speed of the random flicker effect.

properties.name: _FresnelPower
properties.description: Controls edge glow falloff for the hologram rim.

properties.name: _GlitchIntensity
properties.description: Strength of horizontal glitch offset distortion.

shader_graph_nodes: Fresnel Effect node for edge glow with Power property
Position (World).y multiplied by Density, add Time * Speed, then Fraction and Step for scan lines
Sine of (Time * FlickerSpeed), Fraction and Step for flicker mask
Multiply fresnel + scanlines by flicker, connect to Alpha
Set Surface Type to Transparent on the Master Stack, Blend Mode Additive
